nodes.question: How do data-centric policies contribute to the waste management strategies in this phase?
nodes.answer: Data-centric policies target the reuse level by advocating for the right to repair and certifications of high-quality repair, as well as proposing criteria to distinguish waste and regulate waste export at the recycling level.
